question: Should the iPhone shell expose Talk as a first-class Assistant mode, or should it present the parent PR's unified Chat interaction as the sole conversational destination?
rationale: The child changes the top-level mobile hierarchy while its declared parent is still open and defines an incompatible-looking Chat/voice boundary; source review cannot choose the enduring product model safely.

options.title: Align after the parent settles
options.body: Adopt the parent’s accepted Chat/voice contract, rebase this shell on it, and remove or reshape any separate Talk navigation that conflicts with that contract.

options.title: Sponsor a distinct Assistant mode
options.body: Explicitly accept Talk as a durable phone-shell mode and require parent and child changes to document and test the resulting ownership and session behavior together.

recommendation.title: Align after the parent settles
recommendation.body: Adopt the parent’s accepted Chat/voice contract, rebase this shell on it, and remove or reshape any separate Talk navigation that conflicts with that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned reviewer and have already produced exact-head visual comparison evidence for this proposal.
